title: Roro ke ye karti thi bayaan zainab e muztar
body:
RORO KE YE KARTI THI BAYYAN ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR AYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD, SOTE HO KAHAN DASHT MEIN KHURBAN YE MAADAR AAYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
PYAASE THE MAGAR NEHAR KO MUDH KAR NAHI DEKHA, MAADAR SE JO WAADA THA KIYA USKO NIBHAYA, SEHRAABH KARENGE TUMHE ABB SAAQIYE KOUSAR AAYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
NARGHE MEIN HAIN KOOFFAR KE TAHNA MERA BHAIYYA, HAMDAM HAI KOI AUR NA KOI HAI SAHARA, QASIM HAI NA AKBAR HAI NA ABBAS-E-DILAWAR, AAYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
KIS TARHA SE DUKHIYA YE ALAM DIL SE BHULAYE, SAR NAIZOU PA AADA NE TUMHARE HAI CHHADAYE, AB CHEEN NE AAYE HAI MERE SAR SE WO CHADARA, AYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
<<DIVIDER>>
AB JAL CHOOKA AAYE LAADLO ZEHRA KA GULISTAAN, AAYI HAI QAYAMAT KI TARAH SHAAM-E-GHAREEBA , BE YAARO MADAD GAAR HUI ALL-E-PAIYAMBAR, AAYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
FURKHAT KA TUMHARI MERE BACCHO YE ASAR, HAI BE CHAAIN MERA DIL HAI PARESHAAN NAZAR HAI, ITNA TOH BATADOKAHA DHOONDU TUMHE JAAKARA, AYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD
AHSAN YEHI ZAINAB NE KAHA SAJDE MEIN JAAKE, KHURBAAN RAAH-E-HAQ MEIN HUE HAI MERE BACCHE , KARTI THI ADA SHUKRE KHUDA LAASHO PA MAADAR, AAYE OUN-O-MOHAMMAD..
